Form No. 3
G. 25,000-1-34

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 2. Special Branch **〔此处转录不清〕**
REPORT
Date. February 7, 1935.

Subject (in full) Arrest of Kim Toh (金湯) alias Kim Sho Yi (金鐘意),
Korean radical suspect, by the Japanese Consular Police.
Made by J.D.C. Kamashita Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

Kim Toh alias Kim Sho Yi, age 38, unemployed, residing
No. 5 Tuh Ung Li (德興里), Huang Pang Road (橫浜路), Chapei
was arrested by the Japanese Consular Police on the Customs
Jetty at 10.00 a.m. on February 5, 1935 and is being detained
at the Consulate pending investigation.
A further report will be submitted as soon as enquiries
have been completed by the Consular Police.

J. D. C. Kamashita
J. D. C.

Deputy Commissioner, Special Branch.

S2,
Further report please in
due course.
**〔此处转录不清〕**
DC Kamashita.
SMB 8/2.
Feb 1935

表格第3号
G. 25,000-1-34

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S. 2. 特别处 **〔此处转录不清〕**
报告
日期：1935年2月7日。

事由（全称）：日本领事馆警察逮捕朝鲜激进分子嫌疑人金湯（Kim Toh），又名金鐘意（Kim Sho Yi）。
呈报人：J.D.C. Kamashita 转呈人：**〔此处转录不清〕**

金湯，又名金鐘意，38岁，无业，居住于闸北横浜路德興里5号，于1935年2月5日上午10时在海关码头被日本领事馆警察逮捕，目前正被拘留于领事馆内以待调查。
待领事馆警察完成问询后，将提交进一步报告。

J. D. C. Kamashita
J. D. C.

特别处副督察长。

S2，
请在适当时候提交进一步报告。
**〔此处转录不清〕**
副督察长 Kamashita。
SMB 8/2.
1935年2月
